status: Frozen locally after common cache and synthetic contracts, before any tracker output/evaluation on this cohort. Not external preregistration. No post-result tuning.
selection: Full MOT17-04-DPM 1050-frame night elevated-view pedestrian street; no earlier project tracking study on this scene. Selected from official train table, no additional third-party source link. One new static scene, not a held-out benchmark or moving-camera validation. Other third-party scenes excluded when original terms unavailable; MOT20-02 preview downloaded but excluded before tracking because full length exceeds unchanged 1800-frame cache limit. No output-driven replacement or clipping.

source_terms.source_column: No additional third-party source link for MOT17-04-DPM in official table
source_terms.scope: Local non-commercial research only; source media, GT and raw diagnostics not redistributed

interventions.common: Only confirmed selected weak-stage rows, predicted age >=2; candidate active confirmed competitor age 1, similarity >=.1 and selected-minus-competitor <= unchanged .05. All weak inputs remain. No GT or numeric ID comparison across arms.
interventions.activation_control: No veto; observed reference audited against unhooked upstream.
interventions.defer_competing_recovery: Original same-column policy; audited against unchanged original runner.
interventions.defer_available_competitor: Veto only if any eligible active competitor has no gate-accepted assignment to another weak detection in original result. Does not also require alternative-objective equivalence.
interventions.defer_equivalent_assignment: Separately force eligible competitor to target column and solve remaining unfiltered one-to-one matrix with pinned SciPy; veto only if total objective loss <=1e-12 numerical roundoff and gate-admissible pair count >= actual original accepted count. Occupied rows allowed. Does not also require availability. Alternative is never installed. Solver-returned tied optimum only; ties not exhaustively enumerated.
interventions.action: Remove only qualifying originally selected missed-row edges after upstream assignment; do not rematch, claim competitor ownership, update state manually or extend lifetime. Deferred detection remains upstream output as ID -1. Decisions for a frame simultaneous from unmodified assignment.
interventions.unchanged: Activation .3, high .6, buffer30, confirmation2, ordinary active weak continuation, uncontested weak recovery, weak detector cache >=.1, high stage, births, lifecycle, box/score updates, fixed source-FPS, app/worker/defaults/CMC/ReID.

order: Fresh tracker each arm; rotate four arms by repeat index 0/1/2; OpenCV seed0/one thread. Three identical canonical prediction and complete diagnostic trace hashes required. Additional unhooked/legacy audits are not independent repeats.

evaluation.official: Clean TrackEval 12c8791b303e0a0b50f753af204249e622d0281a, official MOT17 pedestrian preprocessing, CLEAR IoU .5, Identity and HOTA all 19 localisation thresholds. Independent local NumPy2 process.
evaluation.screen: For each treatment against activation_control: must trigger, strictly reduce FP, no FN/IDSW increase, no IDF1/HOTA decrease, no loss of same-ID scenario endpoints. Zero exposure is inconclusive, never a passed fix. One-scene pass is not release acceptance.
evaluation.paired_errors: Exact official CLEAR reconciliation; FP keyed by immutable frame/cache detection, FN/IDSW by frame/GT. No cross-arm numeric native ID equality. Raw locations stay local.
evaluation.scenarios: Existing GT-only long-low-visibility/overlap/order-exchange proxies, separate IoU .5 endpoints; not proof of physical occlusion or official scenario metrics.
evaluation.exposure: Report own-history legacy-eligible edges, availability/equivalence and occupied rows per arm; no pooling as independent events, no counterfactual inference by removing old decisions.
evaluation.timing: No throughput or end-to-end timing claim.

limitations: Single new static training preview; not independent held-out official benchmark, moving-camera or general long-occlusion acceptance.
Compressed/downscaled preview and one fixed YOLO26n CPU cache; DPM names identify GT source, supplied DPM detections are not used.
No parameter search; exact equivalent-objective criterion can have zero genuine exposure. Do not relax after result.
Prior bus HOTA failure and prior recall/fragmentation limits remain; no application default promotion or historical release validation.
Raw video/GT/matrices/IDs/diagnostic cases remain local; only aggregate counts/metrics and source/code hashes public.
public_scope: Code, frozen protocol, fixed-label aggregate metrics/counts, provenance and numeric-only plots. No raw media/GT/predictions/IDs/frame locations/paths/credentials.
